{{Quote|Now who will be the first officer to step forward and pledge his loyalty to me?"<br />"I will!|Trioculus and the general|<ref name="The Glove of Darth Vader" />}}
A '''general''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was present at [[Kessendra Stadium]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] when the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] [[Kessendra Coronation|proclaimed]] the mutant slavelord [[Trioculus]] to be the son of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and therefore the next ruler of the Empire. Following a demonstration of Trioculus' so-called [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], the [[General/Legends|general]] expressed eagerness to be the first attendant of the ceremony to pledge his loyalty to him, but was pipped to the post by one of the [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moffs]].<ref name="The Glove of Darth Vader" />
